description: The filesystem and commands the conformance server registers.

commands.name: upper
commands.behavior: copies stdin to stdout uppercased; exit 0 at eof

commands.name: fail
commands.behavior: prints 'failing' to stderr and exits with argv[1]

commands.name: wait
commands.behavior: prints 'waiting' and blocks until INT (exit 130) or KILL

commands.name: env
commands.behavior: prints the received env as NAME=value lines, sorted
